description: This Python module provides a comprehensive subtitle correction pipeline. It includes features for normalizing subtitle text, applying grammar and spell corrections, enforcing OTT compliance rules (such as line length and punctuation), and optionally integrating automatic speech recognition (ASR) for audio-aware subtitle harmonization. The module manages optional dependencies gracefully and is designed to be integrated into larger subtitle processing workflows.

methods.name: List[Dict] correct_subtitles_pipeline( cues: List[Dict], *, language: str = "en", enable_grammar: bool = True, enable_ott_rules: bool = True, enable_audio_correction: bool = False, audio_source: Optional[str] = None, asr_model_name: Optional[str] = None, asr_device: Optional[str] = None, transcript: Optional[List[Dict]] = None, )
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates the subtitle correction process including normalization, grammar correction, OTT rule enforcement, and optional audio correction.

methods.name: str _normalize_text(text: str)
methods.description: Normalizes whitespace, punctuation spacing, and quotes in subtitle text.

methods.name: None _apply_grammar_and_spell_corrections(cues: List[Dict], language: str = "en")
methods.description: Applies grammar and spelling corrections using language_tool_python if available.

methods.name: bool _is_change_reasonable(original: str, corrected: str)
methods.description: Determines if corrections are acceptable by comparing original and corrected text.

methods.name: None _apply_ott_compliance_rules( cues: List[Dict], *, language: str = "en", max_lines_per_cue: int = 2, max_chars_per_line: int = 42, enforce_terminal_punctuation: bool = False, )
methods.description: Enforces baseline OTT compliance rules, like line length, line count, terminal punctuation, and reading speed heuristics.

methods.name: List[str] _wrap_text(text: str, max_chars: int, max_lines: int)
methods.description: Wraps text into lines constrained by maximum character length and line limit.

methods.name: str _adjust_for_reading_speed(text: str)
methods.description: Adjusts text for reading speed heuristics if textstat is available.

methods.name: None _apply_audio_aware_corrections( cues: List[Dict], *, audio_source: Optional[str], language: str = "en", asr_model_name: Optional[str] = None, asr_device: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Uses ASR transcription to harmonize subtitle text with spoken audio content.

methods.name: List[Dict] _run_asr( audio_source: str, *, language: str, model_name: Optional[str], device: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Executes ASR transcriptions using available libraries (faster-whisper or whisper).

methods.name: str _collect_asr_text_for_window(segments: List[Dict], start: float, end: float)
methods.description: Collects relevant ASR text overlapping a subtitle cue's time window.

methods.name: bool _overlaps(a_start: float, a_end: float, b_start: float, b_end: float)
methods.description: Checks if two time intervals overlap.

methods.name: str _harmonize_text_with_asr(sub_text: str, asr_text: str)
methods.description: Reconciles subtitle text with ASR output using fuzzy token matching, maintaining structure.

methods.name: List[str] _tokenize(text: str)
methods.description: Splits text into tokens preserving punctuation.

methods.name: str _detokenize(tokens: List[str])
methods.description: Reconstructs text from tokens with proper spacing.

methods.name: str _match_casing(source: str, template: str)
methods.description: Adjusts source string's casing to match a template string.
